dynamical-spacetime.title: Einstein Field Equations with Cosmological Constant
dynamical-spacetime.description: Governs the gravitational dynamics of spacetime curvature in response to the distribution of mass-energy and momentum, establishing spacetime as a dynamical participant rather than a static background.

holographic-link.title: Ryu-Takayanagi Entanglement Entropy Formula
holographic-link.description: Relates the quantum entanglement entropy of a boundary subregion to the area of a minimal bulk surface in a holographic duality, bridging quantum information and spacetime geometry.

variational-foundation.title: Hamilton's Principle of Stationary Action
variational-foundation.description: Establishes that the physical trajectories of fields or particles are those that render the action functional stationary under all variations vanishing at the boundaries.

nuclear-cross-sections.title: Differential Nuclear Cross-Section
nuclear-cross-sections.description: Defines the differential nuclear cross-section as the ratio of the number of scattered particles per unit solid angle per unit time to the incident particle flux, governing the probability of specific scattering or reaction events.

quantum-tunneling-nuclear.title: Gamow Tunneling Probability and Coulomb Barrier Penetration
quantum-tunneling-nuclear.description: Formulates the quantum mechanical tunneling probability through the electrostatic Coulomb barrier for two interacting nuclei, governed by the Gamow parameter \eta.

pp-chain.title: Proton-Proton Chain Fusion Energy Generation Rate
pp-chain.description: Expresses the specific energy generation rate of the proton-proton chain fusion reactions as a non-linear function of stellar density, hydrogen mass fraction, and temperature.

parallax-baseline.title: Trigonometric Parallax Distance Relation
parallax-baseline.description: Formulates the trigonometric relation between the distance d of a celestial object, the parallax baseline b, and the observed parallax angle p, establishing the primary astronomical metric for local distance measurements.

parsec-definition.title: Trigonometric Parsec Definition
parsec-definition.description: Defines the parsec as the absolute physical distance at which an astronomical unit baseline subtends a parallax angle of exactly one arcsecond.

adiabatic-processes.title: Poisson Adiabatic Gas Relation
adiabatic-processes.description: Governs the pressure-density relation for a fluid parcel undergoing adiabatic expansion or compression without heat exchange, characterized by the adiabatic index \gamma.

topological-bh.title: Gauss-Bonnet Theorem for Horizon Topology
topological-bh.description: Relates the integrated Ricci curvature of a stationary black hole event horizon to its Euler characteristic, topologically constraining the horizon to a genus zero sphere.

unitarity-physics.title: Unitarity and Probability Conservation
unitarity-physics.description: Formulates the mathematical definition of a unitary operator, guaranteeing probability conservation and the preservation of inner products during quantum state evolution.

kappa-mechanism.title: Stellar Opacity Perturbation Relation
kappa-mechanism.description: Expresses the Rosseland mean opacity as a power law function of stellar density and temperature, governing the radiative transport perturbations that drive stellar pulsations.

interstellar-extinction.title: Cardelli-Clayton-Mathis Extinction Law
interstellar-extinction.description: Expresses the ratio of monochromatic extinction to total visual extinction as a function of inverse wavelength and the total-to-selective extinction ratio, characterizing interstellar dust grain properties.

hubble-telescope-astrometry.title: Hubble Centroid Astrametric Precision Limit
hubble-telescope-astrometry.description: Formulates the fundamental astrometric precision limit for centroiding a point source, scaling directly with the diffraction-limited angular resolution and inversely with the signal-to-noise ratio.

jwst-astrometry.title: Infrared Astrometric Centroid Precision
jwst-astrometry.description: Formulates the diffraction-limited astrometric centroiding precision in the infrared regime as a function of the observing wavelength, primary aperture diameter, and signal-to-noise ratio.
